concerns.text: The external validation set is sampled from the same OQMD dataset used for training. This does not provide an independent assessment of generalization and conflicts with FR‑013, which expects an external hold‑out set from a different source (Materials Project). Relying on the same source may inflate performance estimates.

The power analysis assumes an effect size f² ≈ 4 (corresponding to R² = 0.80), which is unrealistically large for materials‑property prediction. Using such a generous effect size can severely over‑estimate power, risking an under‑powered study if the true effect is smaller.

The plan omits any modeling of Curie temperature because no verified dataset is available. Consequently, the core research question—how alloying determines *both* saturation magnetization **and** Curie temperature—cannot be answered. Unless a verified Curie‑temperature dataset is supplied, the study will remain incomplete.
